title: PyGoat Sentinel — DevSecOps Security Control Center
description: Visualises the decision of the PyGoat Security Gate (GitLab CI). Grafana never decides.

options.content:
### SCANNERS DETECT → SECURITY GATE DECIDES → GRAFANA VISUALISES
This dashboard **only displays** the decision taken by `ci/security_gate.py` with the versioned policy `ci/security-policy.toml`. It never authorises or blocks a release. Data: `reports/security-summary.json` of each GitLab pipeline (live) and `monitoring/history/security-history.json` (validated historical snapshots).

panels.title: 1 · Security Gate
panels.description: Decision of ci/security_gate.py for the latest exported pipeline of the branch.

panels.title: 2 · Blocking findings
panels.description: Findings above the policy thresholds (a missing report counts as 1 blocker: fail-secure).

panels.title: 3 · Release
panels.description: release_allowed as written by the Security Gate. deploy:production also requires a manual approval.

panels.title: 4 · Blockers by control
panels.description: Blocking findings per scanner in the latest pipeline.

panels.title: 5 · Warnings by control
panels.description: Non-blocking findings (reported, reviewed, they do not stop the release).

panels.title: 6 · Remediation journey — blocking findings per phase (historical)
7 · Blocker-count reduction (historical) — not a security score
panels.description: (first - last) / first number of BLOCKING findings between the initial baseline and the final snapshot. It measures how many policy violations were removed; it is NOT a percentage of how secure the application is.

options.content:
## BEFORE vs AFTER — SECURITY POSTURE
Validated **blocking findings** (policy `ci/security-policy.toml`) at the initial baseline `7ccd7b4` and at the secure baseline `5a3b908`. Blocking findings include vulnerabilities, exposed secrets and policy / configuration findings. Blocker-count reduction is **NOT a security score**.

panels.title: BEFORE — Initial baseline (7ccd7b4)
panels.description: HISTORICAL validated snapshot 1-initial-baseline. Gate and release derived from the blocker count (> 0 blocking findings ⇒ BLOCKED).

panels.title: TRANSFORMATION — blocking findings, before → after
panels.description: Blocking findings at the initial baseline (left) and at the secure baseline (right).

panels.title: AFTER — Current secure baseline (5a3b908)
panels.description: HISTORICAL validated snapshot 5-final-secure-baseline: 0 blocking findings on all 8 controls ⇒ PASS, release authorised. The live state of the latest pipeline is shown in panels 1-3.

panels.title: BEFORE — Initial blockers by control
panels.description: Validated blocking findings per control at 7ccd7b4 (total 1104).

panels.title: Blocker-count reduction — NOT a security score
panels.description: Number of blocking findings removed between 7ccd7b4 and 5a3b908, and (before - after) / before. It counts policy violations that were removed; it is NOT a measure of how secure the application is.

properties.value: reduction in blocker count — NOT a security score

panels.title: AFTER — Blockers by control (all 8 controls)
panels.description: Validated blocking findings per control at 5a3b908: 0 on every control.

panels.title: Security improvement summary — before vs after (blocking findings)
panels.description: Validated blocking findings by category. Secrets = Gitleaks; SAST = Semgrep + Bandit; Dependency/Image = Trivy FS + Trivy Image; IaC = Trivy Config + Checkov; DAST (ZAP) = 0 in both snapshots. Counted as blocking findings: they include CVEs, exposed secrets and policy / configuration findings.

panels.title: 8 · Security Gate history (live pipelines)
panels.description: 1 = PASS, 0 = BLOCKED. One point per exported pipeline (range query on the live metric); the stepped line joins consecutive pipeline decisions.

panels.title: 9 · Control status matrix (latest pipeline)
panels.description: One row per control. Status 0 + Evidence REPORT OK = blocked by findings. Status 0 + Evidence MISSING = the scanner report was not produced: no security evidence, counted as a blocker by the gate (fail-secure).

panels.title: 10 · Pipeline & commit context
panels.description: Pipelines exported in the selected time range, highest (latest) pipeline ID first. Click a pipeline ID to open it in GitLab.

targets.expr: max by (project, commit_short_sha, pipeline_id, gate_status) (last_over_time(pygoat_security_pipeline_info{project="$project", branch="$branch"}[$__range]))
